PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING

A very small percentage of people may experience a seizure when exposed to flashing lights or visual patterns, including in video games. This can happen even to people with no history of seizures or epilepsy.

This game contains explosions, muzzle flashes, searchlights, lightning, rapidly changing light and screen effects.

Stop playing immediately and consult a doctor if you experience dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, loss of awareness, disorientation, involuntary movement or convulsions.

Play in a well-lit room, sit a safe distance from the screen, and take a break of at least 10 minutes every hour. Do not play when drowsy or tired.

WW2 Channel Air War

Last updated: 22 October 2026

The short version: the Game does not collect personal data, has no accounts, no advertising and no analytics, and does not contact any server unless you ask it to download the optional NVIDIA DLSS components.

1. WHO IS RESPONSIBLE
[PUBLISHER NAME] ("we") is responsible for this policy. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL].

The Game stores the following on your own computer only, in the Game's user data folder: settings (graphics, audio, controls), your pilot log and career progress, saved campaign state, per-aircraft camera zoom, and a record that you accepted the licence agreement and warnings. We do not receive any of this. Delete the folder to remove it.

None. We do not collect your name, email address, location, device identifiers, play statistics or crash reports.

The Game works offline. It connects to the internet only if you press "Download DLSS components", in which case it downloads a file from NVIDIA's public GitHub repository (github.com). If you obtain the Game through a store or launcher (for example Steam), that platform processes your data under its own privacy policy. We do not control it.

The Game is rated for a general audience of older children and adults and does not knowingly collect any data from anyone, including children.

Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to access, correct or delete. If you contact us we will process your message only to reply to it.
